GRADE 4 SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY — TERM 2 EXAM

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY
Time: 30 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Light in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. a) identify the sources of light in nature,
   B. Learners should ignore Light completely.
   C. Light is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Light.

2. About Light around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. b) describe ways of lighting a house in day- to- day life,
   B. Learners should ignore Light completely.
   C. Light is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Light.

3. About Light in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. c) explain the uses of light in day-to-day life,
   B. Learners should ignore Light completely.
   C. Light is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Light.

5. About Heat in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. a) identify sources of heat in nature,
   B. Learners should ignore Heat completely.
   C. Heat is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Heat.

6. About Heat around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. b) demonstrate uses of heat in day-to-day life,
   B. Learners should ignore Heat completely.
   C. Heat is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Heat.

7. About Heat in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. c) describe safety measures to observe when using heat,
   B. Learners should ignore Heat completely.
   C. Heat is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Heat.

9. Which habit helps you revise SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY successfully?
   A. Read notes, practise questions, then check answers
   B. Skip revision and guess everything
   C. Memorise titles only
   D. Avoid asking for help

10. Which habit helps you revise SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY successfully?
   A. Read notes, practise questions, then check answers
   B. Skip revision and guess everything
   C. Memorise titles only
   D. Avoid asking for help

11. Which habit helps you revise SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY successfully?
   A. Read notes, practise questions, then check answers
   B. Skip revision and guess everything
   C. Memorise titles only
   D. Avoid asking for help

12. Which habit helps you revise SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY successfully?
   A. Read notes, practise questions, then check answers
   B. Skip revision and guess everything
   C. Memorise titles only
   D. Avoid asking for help

SECTION B: Short Answers

4. Give two examples of how you can use Light in your school compound.
